svg.title: Tool Call Judge: a second model can stop a tool call
svg.desc: ToolCallJudge runs in the before_tool_execute hook, after the arguments are validated and before the tool function runs. A second model is asked one question about the call delete_file(path='./old-report.txt'). A yes blocks the call and the model gets the denial message instead of a result; a no lets the tool run; unsure or a failed judgement follows on_uncertain, which blocks by default.
